findings.body:
Empty-matrix always fails, so any non-`ready` `labeled` event re-fails the required check on the same head SHA after a successful review.

Sequence: apply `ready` → legs + gate go green → apply `bug`/`dependencies` → `scope` emits `matrix=[]` (correct) → this block `exit 1` → latest `Self-review gate` check on the SHA is red → merge blocked again. Branch protection keys off the latest check run name, and `on.pull_request.types` includes every label.

Fix: on empty matrix, fail only when this head SHA has no prior successful self-review (check-runs for `Self-review — *` or a prior green gate on `github.event.pull_request.head.sha`); if one exists, exit 0. Still fail when `SCOPE_RESULT != success` or when the matrix ran and `REVIEW_RESULT != success`. Same hole is copied in `docs/TRIGGER_MODES.md` technique 3.

Comment says the only path to an empty matrix (with secrets configured) is a missing `ready` label, but `matrix` also stays `[]` when `ready` is present and every `HAS_*` secret is unset — the gate still fails with “apply the ready label”.

Low likelihood in this repo’s dogfood, but the user-facing `::error::` then points maintainers at the wrong fix. Consider branching the message on whether `ready` is present vs secrets missing, or noting the secrets case in the comment.

summary:
## Verdict

Solid diagnosis of the Skipped-required-check gotcha, and the stable-named `Self-review gate` is the right shape for branch protection. One real correctness hole remains: the gate fails on **every** empty-matrix run, including unrelated `labeled` events after a successful review on the same SHA, which flips a green required check back to red.

## Findings

| # | Severity | File | Summary |
|---|----------|------|---------|
| 1 | ⚠️ warning | `.github/workflows/self-review.yml:238` | Empty-matrix path always fails — unrelated labels re-block after a green review |
| 2 | ℹ️ info | `.github/workflows/self-review.yml:234` | Error copy assumes empty matrix only means missing `ready` |

## Details

**Unrelated-label overwrite.** `on.pull_request.types` includes all `labeled` events. `scope` correctly emits `matrix=[]` for non-`ready` labels (and the review leg stays Skipped), but the new `gate` job still runs via `if: always()` and exits 1 on empty matrix. Branch protection uses the **latest** check run named `Self-review gate` on the head SHA, so:

1. Apply `ready` → review passes → gate green → mergeable  
2. Apply `bug` / `dependencies` / any other label → new workflow run → gate red on the same SHA → merge blocked again  

That breaks the documented happy path (“gate turn green → mergeable”) whenever maintainers use other labels after dogfood. The docs recipe in `TRIGGER_MODES.md` technique 3 copies the same pattern.

**Fix direction:** on empty matrix, fail only when this head SHA has no successful self-review yet (e.g. query check-runs for `Self-review — *` / prior gate success on `github.event.pull_request.head.sha`); if a prior success exists for this SHA, exit 0. Keep failing hard when matrix is non-empty and `REVIEW_RESULT != success`, and when `scope` itself failed.
